content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Winston-Salem

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's dual-track requirements: one path combines a bachelor's degree with documented hours leading projects; the alternative requires a high school diploma plus additional project experience. Verify your credentials meet PMI standards before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course designed for working professionals in Winston-Salem's healthcare, banking, manufacturing, and logistics sectors. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and master the PMBOK® Guide framework required for exam success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI with proof of your education, project experience, and training completion. Pay PMI's exam fee and await approval. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence before your scheduled exam. Register with Pearson VUE and sit for the computer-based PMP examination. Your training instructor remains available to answer final questions and clarify difficult concepts.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by completing PMI-approved training, volunteering, or presenting on project-management topics. Track your PDUs in your PMI account and renew before your expiration date to keep your credential active and competitive in your market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
